title: GenWave Avatar Pack Catalog Entry Metadata
description: The <slug>.meta.json shape for a kind:"avatar" entry (app repo SPEC F128.1, catalog-owned). Mirrors font-meta.schema.json's posture: additionalProperties is false — this document belongs entirely to the catalog, so an unrecognized field is a contributor mistake worth failing CI on, not a forward-compat concern. There is no `preview`/`samplePatter` equivalent (an avatar pack has neither a swatch set nor on-air sample lines); the pack's shelf card renders from `packName` (the manifest's own field) plus author/description/byte total instead.
$comment: `added`'s pattern ends in (?![\s\S]), the same portable absolute-end-of-string anchor persona-meta.schema.json/theme-meta.schema.json/font-meta.schema.json document in full and repeat verbatim — repeated here too so this file stands alone.

author.description: Who submitted this pack — third-party avatar-pack PRs are welcome (unlike font packs), gated on the same likeness/CC0 attestation the PR template asks of every image-carrying entry (SPEC F128.1).

description.description: A short blurb introducing the pack — shown on the shelf card without fetching the manifest.

audience.description: Content self-rating, verified at review (mirrors every other kind's own `audience`).

added.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) this pack was added to the catalog. `format: date` alone is annotation-only in draft-07 by default, so `pattern` carries the shape enforcement — but pattern alone only checks digit counts, not calendar validity; tools/validate.py separately parses this value with datetime.date.fromisoformat to reject a shape-valid but non-existent date.

bestFor.description: Optional use-case hints, e.g. "late-night", "retro" — mirrors every other kind's own `bestFor`.
